correctness.rationale: Direct symbolic expansion of the repaired final V gives exact dotV=-2α(k−α)x²/k−2k(y−α/k)²−2αβb z² for all real x,y,z and positive parameters. V is coercive; α<k is strict negative definiteness. α=k yields zero set y=1,z=0 with z'=x there, so largest invariant subset is E; forward completeness and LaSalle prove GAS. Uniqueness of E follows by eliminating equilibrium equations. This is an infinite symbolic proof, not dependent on finite simulation.

value.rationale: The critical equality face α=k of a natural global stability region was excluded by the published strict theorem, and merely approaching the face from strict α<k does not prove global attraction there. The exact invariant-set closure is a substantive boundary fact for this physical dynamo, and a corrected cross-term-free certificate rigorously repairs a parameter-uniform proof defect in the published theorem. This is modest but motivated: it supplies the parameter-complete closed half-space, not an arbitrary tiny numerical gain. Does not claim necessity or new strict-interior coverage.
